title: Wire EDM Studio — Full Capability Enhancement (Taper/UV, Surface Integrity, Quality, Adaptive Control)
brief: Exposes all 45 remaining backend Wire EDM capabilities through the wizard UI. Covers: 4-axis UV taper visualization, wire management (threading/break recovery/slug handling), full surface integrity suite (recast mapping, HAZ, microcracks, fatigue prediction), industry spec compliance (AMS 2628, ASTM F136 / ISO 13485 / ISO 5832-3), quality gates with Predicted Pp (Process Performance), adaptive process control, Monte Carlo uncertainty, technology table mapping, distortion compensation, setup documentation with diagrams, and Bayesian learning from job history.

formulas: Taper UV: U = tan(α) × H/2, accuracy: ε = (wire_dia/2) × sin(α) × H / guide_distance (sin(α) term required — at α=0, ε=0)
Wire lag: δ = F × L² / (8T), over-travel: OT = δ × sin(θ/2) / sin(θ)
Rajurkar (1993) Wire EDM cutting speed: v_cut [mm/min] = (K × I_peak × t_on) / (h × D_wire)
Carslaw-Jaeger recast: d_recast [μm] = 2 × √(α [mm²/s] × t_on [s]) × 1e6. CANONICAL MODEL — use this, not DiBitonto.
Skim pass attenuation: d_n = d_0 × k^N where k is material-dependent (steel 0.7, Ti/WC 0.80, Al 0.65). CANONICAL value in constants.ts.
HAZ = material_multiplier × recast (steel 3×, Ti 2×, Al 8×, Ni-alloy 4×) — NOT fixed 3×
Fatigue reduction (normalized): min(70%, (d_rc/d_ref)×w_d + (σ_r/σ_ref)×w_σ) where d_ref=10μm, σ_ref=400MPa
Puertas & Luis surface roughness model — Constants C_ra, α, β are material-dependent: H13 α≈0.417 β≈0.210 (Puertas & Luis 2003)
Wire break: P(break) = 1 - exp(-λ × H × DC / FF) — Weibull hazard model
Stokes drag: v_settle = (ρ_p - ρ_f) × d² × g / (18μ) — debris evacuation
Monte Carlo: 1000 samples, Box-Muller normal, exponential energy, Weibull life
standards: AMS 2628 — Aerospace Wire EDM surface integrity requirements. AMS 2628A per-material limits: tool steel max 8-12 um, titanium alloys max 5-8 um (1.27 um = 50 uin per S3.2.3), nickel superalloys max 8-12 um, stainless steel max 10-15 um. Zero recast = ideal target, NOT the spec limit.
ASTM F136 — Titanium alloy implant material requirements (chemical etching for recast removal)
ISO 13485 — Quality management for medical devices (traceability requirements)
NADCAP AC7117/9 — Wire EDM process accreditation (aerospace)
AS9102 — First Article Inspection reporting format

U-WEDM32.title: Quality gates with Predicted Pp (Process Performance) + dimensional verification planner
U-WEDM32.description: Quality gate panel in StepProgram (before download): per-feature Predicted Pp (Process Performance) estimate (from multi-pass tolerance analysis). Gate criteria: Predicted Pp >= 1.33 (capable), >= 1.67 (excellent). Gate status: green/yellow/red. Dimensional verification plan: which features to measure, with what instrument (CMM touch, scanning, optical), at which z-heights. Probe point count per feature. Gate must pass before G-code download enabled. Label as 'Predicted Pp' NOT 'Cpk' — Cpk requires >=25 measured subgroups per AIAG SPC Manual. Predicted Pp is from physics model variance. Add disclaimer: 'Based on predicted variation model, not measured SPC data.' Add job_intent field: 'rough_blank' | 'finished_part' | 'electrode'. Quality gate (Predicted Pp) applies only to 'finished_part'. Rough blanks and electrodes bypass quality gate but generate disclosure note. Quality gate override requires: (1) typed reason code (engineering deviation / risk acceptance / customer waiver), (2) approver name + badge number, (3) timestamp, (4) reference number. Override recorded in job audit trail. Setup sheet stamped 'QUALITY GATE OVERRIDE — [reason] — [approver] — [timestamp]'. Required per AS9100 Rev D Clause 8.7. Quality gate override form is fully keyboard-accessible with labeled inputs. Gate fail status uses aria-live='assertive'. Override confirmation dialog traps focus.
abort_criteria: Predicted Pp not calculated from tolerance + expected variation
Quality gate doesn't block download when Predicted Pp < 1.33
Verification plan missing probe type selection
Gate override accepted without reason string or approver identity
U-WEDM32.exit_gate: Predicted Pp shown per feature. Quality gate blocks download when non-compliant. Verification plan with probe types and z-heights generated.
U-WEDM32.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE (quality-expert) → GAP FILL (edge: single-pass jobs) → TIE UP (gate override with reason)

U-WEDM43.description: Job history panel (new section in wizard, accessible from step 1): past jobs list with material, thickness, wire type, cycle time, actual Ra, actual cost. Bayesian parameter priors: model updates parameter estimates based on actual vs predicted. Visual: predicted vs actual scatter plot for Ra, cycle time, cost. Job history panel includes 'Clone Job' button: copies all wizard state from a past job into a new session with only the DXF file slot empty. One-click variant creation for repeat/similar jobs.
